title: Myth vs Fact
why: Objection killer for warm leads who are hesitating: four common fears, each answered with a checkable fact.
hook_options: Four things people get wrong about our boats
What your group chat thinks vs what actually happens
Myths we hear every single week
caption: Rain, strangers, boating skills, guaranteed gators. Four things people worry about before they book, and what actually happens on Bayou Bienvenue. Send it to the friend who keeps saying maybe. #neworleans #nolapartybarge #swamptour #bayoubienvenue

slides.headline: Four things people get wrong about our boats
Rain ruins a bayou party
slides.body: Everyone checks the forecast 40 times the week before.

slides.headline: Covered deck. Lightning cancels, rain doesn't.
slides.body: There is a roof over the whole deck. If lightning shows up, the captain makes the call.

slides.headline: Party boat means partying with strangers
slides.body: Nobody wants a stranger in the group photo.

slides.headline: Private means your group only
slides.body: Freaky Tiki, Twerkin' Tiki, Party Queen, or Bayou Boogie. Nobody else boards. Want company? Book social seats.

slides.headline: You need to know boats
slides.body: Who drives? Who ties up at the dock? Who knows where the gators hang out?

slides.headline: A licensed captain runs the whole trip
slides.body: USCG-certified boat, licensed captain, a deckhand. Your only job is the playlist.

slides.headline: Gators are guaranteed
slides.body: Some tours promise one. Ask them how.

slides.headline: Gators are common, not guaranteed
slides.body: They are wild, seasonal, and weather dependent. We look hard. We never promise.

slides.headline: Now you know. Pick your boat.
